files.content:
# Northstar Studio notes

Customer: Northstar Studio, 48-person interior design firm.
Challenge: returns questions consumed two support coordinators every Monday and order context lived in email threads.
Solution: HarborCRM guided returns intake plus triage queue, launched March 2026.
Before/after metrics: median first response fell from 18 hours to 6 hours; preventable refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%; onboarding for new coordinators fell from 11 days to 4 days.
Approved quote 1: "The queue gave us one place to see what mattered first," said Lena Ortiz, Director of Client Operations.
Approved quote 2: "We stopped hunting through inboxes before every customer call," said Marco Reed, Support Lead.
Takeaway: operations teams can reduce refund leakage without adding headcount.
CTA: Book a returns workflow audit.
